preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
For each test case, K must be a positive integer and N must be at least K and at most 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each node value A[i] must be a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the valid range of 1 to N.
The total number of nodes across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible value of the bitwise AND of the XOR sums of the K trees.
